talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.hire.ask: Between ships, and my purse says so. %s in coin and I'll sail yours six days, any course you name that I know. Cast her off and call me to her wheel.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.hire.ask.crosse: Between ships. I've been east over the deep water once, in the wake of one of their traders, and I could raise that shore again. %s in coin, six days. Cast her off and call me to her wheel.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.hire.done: Done. Show me your ship. Once she's off her moorings, call me to the wheel.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.hire.over: That's my six days. Fair winds to you. I'll be about the harbour if you want me again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.ask.hand: I'll take her, though I'm no sailor. I'll keep the sail short. Where to?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.ask.again: Still at the wheel. New orders?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.taken: There's someone at her wheel already.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.no_wheel: I can't get to her wheel.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.option.far: Make for the land in the east
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.course.as_she_g: Steady as she goes. Get some rest. I'll shout if I see land.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.course.east: Due east it is. I'll shout if I see land.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.course.west: Due west it is. I'll shout if I see land.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.course.north: Due north it is. I'll shout if I see land.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.course.south: Due south it is. I'll shout if I see land.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.course.far: East, then, and a long way of it. Two days and two nights if the wind holds. See to your stores. There's nothing out there but the Tideborn's rocks.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.follow: I'll keep in her wake. %s won't shake us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.follow.none: Follow what? There's no sail in sight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.follow.lost: I've lost her. Hove to until you say where next.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.land: Land across our course, and no way round it that I can see. I've hove her to. Say where next.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.landfall: There. Low on the water ahead, with the pink of blossom on the hills. That's the shore I told you of. I'll lie off it. Where she goes in is yours to say.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.anchor.way: She's still got way on her. I'll bring her to. Ask me again when she lies still.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.helm.anchor.no_room: No room to let go here. Too close in.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.0: A ship came in last season, built like nothing from these yards. Square sails ribbed like a fan. She sold her cargo and went out east again without a word.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.1: My aunt has a cup, black and red, with a shine on it like still water. Bought off a foreign trader. No one here knows how it's made.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.2: There's a knife in the lord's hall no smith can match. The steel has a grain in it like wood. It came over the sea, they say. Nobody says from where.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.3: Old Tam sailed east after one of those strange traders. Four ships went. His came back. He won't say what he saw, only that the hills were pink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.4: You've seen a cherry grove? Folk say those are only the strays. Blown seed. The trees have a country of their own, somewhere.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.5: The roads end at the sea and the milestones with them. But the sea doesn't end there, does it? Something's on the other side of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.6: A pedlar sold me a pinch of dried leaf to steep in hot water. Bitter, and I slept badly, and I'd buy it again. He said it came off a ship.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.7: East of here is water, and east of that is more water. Two days of it, a sailor told me, and then he stopped talking and looked at his drink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.8: The fish folk on the far rocks trade with ships we never see in our harbours. Ask them who, and they smile at you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.9: My grandfather fought beside a man in lacquered armour who bowed before he drew. Went home after the war, he said. East. He didn't mean the next kingdom.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.10: Paper so thin the lamp shines through it, and stronger than our vellum. The scribe keeps one sheet locked up. Says there's no more to be had this side of the water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.11: There's no chart of it. I asked the harbour master. He laughed, then he asked me who'd been talking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.sailor.0: I've seen their ships hull down in the east at dawn. They don't come from any port I know, and I know them all.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.sailor.1: Two days and nights with no land but the Tideborn's rocks. That's what the ones who came back say. Most don't say anything.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.sailor.2: You want to go east? Find a hand who's made the crossing. There's a few of us about the harbours. No chart will take you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.sailor.3: The traders with the fan sails pay in steel and take their water on at the fish folk's islands. I've watched them do it. They don't linger.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.sailor.4: A mate of mine followed one of them home. Came back with a cask of rice wine and a bow in his manners. Wouldn't sign on with us again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.east.sailor.5: There's a navy out there, in the far east water. Hails you polite, with the guns run out. So I heard. I've not been so far myself.
